requirement: The declaration of quantity shall be expressed in terms of such unit of weight, measure or number or a combination of weight, measure or number as would give an accurate and adequate information to the consumer with regard to the quantity of the commodity contained in the package
source_document: Download The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
evidence_text:
Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be.—(1) The declaration
of quantity shall be expressed in terms of such unit of weight, measure or
number or a combination of weight, measure or number as would give an
accurate and adequate information to the consumer with regard to the quantity
of the commodity contained in the package
